phase: Operational Incidents register and response popup

requirements.requirement: List all authorised incidents in a compact register with status totals, status and severity filters, search, and pagination.
requirements.uiReference: User screenshots of Operational Incidents with response forms expanded under each incident
requirements.securityControl: Authenticated API and existing role/branch scope apply to rows, search and totals; response is private and not cached.
requirements.reason: The default register includes every status, and older records are reachable via server pagination.
requirements.testResult: PASS · Focused locally executed regression and Chrome browsing/search.
requirements.outstandingWork: Verify on the final commercial release candidate when authorised.

requirements.requirement: Show a per-row Actions menu that opens details or an authorised response popup without changing the table layout.
requirements.uiReference: User screenshots of Operational Incidents with response forms expanded under each incident
requirements.dataSource: Selected scoped operational_incidents row and server canManage flag
requirements.securityControl: Record response is shown to authorised roles; incident.update independently enforces write access.
requirements.reason: Only one requested popup appears at a time. Read-only Finance users can still inspect details.
requirements.testResult: PASS · Authenticated desktop/light and mobile/dark Chrome checks.
requirements.outstandingWork: Verify on the final commercial release candidate when authorised.

requirements.requirement: Save corrective action or evidence with acknowledgement or resolution, enforcing existing permission and review rules.
requirements.uiReference: User screenshots of Operational Incidents with response forms expanded under each incident
requirements.dataSource: operational_incidents status, incident_events evidence and existing audit trail
requirements.securityControl: Server rechecks role, branch, safety resolution authority, password verification and independent dispute review. Failed validation does not write incident events.
requirements.reason: The existing incident transaction persists responses and audit history. The popup preserves entries when password verification is requested.
requirements.testResult: PASS · Scoped-write regression and authenticated dispute-response completion in Chrome.
requirements.outstandingWork: Response writes verified in the isolated database. Repeat on the final acceptance environment with approved test records.

requirements.requirement: Fit the incident register to the available workspace width with every field and its Actions control visible without horizontal scrolling.
requirements.uiReference: 17 November screenshot of overflowing Operational Incidents table
requirements.dataSource: Existing scoped operational incidents, branch labels and timestamps
requirements.securityControl: Existing role and branch scoping controls the register and response popup. Finance retains read access.
requirements.reason: The fixed desktop table and stacked rows constrain content to the available workspace. A two-line preview wraps long references and the details dialog renders the full description.
requirements.testResult: PASS — local authenticated Chrome and Firefox layout and interaction checks ADM-INC-LAYOUT-01/02.
requirements.outstandingWork: Repeat the responsive check after the updated layout is deployed to the demo.

gates.requirement: Render a compact register with server counts and find older records beyond the legacy read cap with no branch leakage.
Open and dismiss Actions without reflow, inspect details on desktop and mobile, and hide editing for read-only roles.
Persist a valid response and deny unauthorised writes, missing evidence or missing required verification.
Confirm the page, register, filters and popups fit every tested width, with all six fields accessible, in Chrome and Firefox.

changeLog.change: Added responsive register coverage ADM-INC-R04/G04. Existing incident listing, response and permissions gates carry forward.
